expected_value_creation: A canonical, AI-verifiable QIF baseline lets humans and agents discover organization-specific quality intent, collect evidence, compute confidence, issue verdicts, and govern lifecycle changes without treating output volume as quality.
beneficiary: Quality leaders, auditors, project teams, operators, AI agents, and hybrid organizations applying QIF
supporting_evidence: The framed session identifies canonical schemas, workflows, governance, and acceptance criteria as the success condition.
The prior quality theory defines quality as value realization within loss boundaries, supported by evidence and learning rather than activity counts.
success_criteria: Entity model covers purpose, attributes, lifecycle, and relationships for core QIF entities.
Discovery, evaluation, governance, and acceptance workflows are documented and machine-verifiable.
A sample QIF package validates through a local validator.
